summary: New sense 1: (Detrans.) sich beruhigen, sich trösten
rationale: Makes explicit the emotional-state meaning already exemplified in both inherited Detransitive boxes.

data.turoyo: Mawbele su abrayḏux, efendim, d msahele, balki nofəl raḥa ebe w noyaḥle.
data.translation: Bring ihn zu deinem Sohne, damit er ihn tröstet. Vielleicht findet er dann Ruhe und wird gesund.

rationale: Thin Infectum cell; purpose d msahele contrasts with the homographic Preterit.

data.turoyo: W msahele. Qambar Zaman ġalabe gəmsahele.
data.translation: So tröstete er Qambar Zaman aufs Beste.

rationale: Thin Infectum cell: overt narrative gə- and fronted/resumed patient. The edition renders the two comforting predicates together, so both are quoted.

data.turoyo: Hano ste, məllele, omər: “Ya aḥuno, Qambar Zaman!” Omər: “Mən yo?” Omər: “De, gmaḥənno b odakke harke w gəzzi, msahanno ḥoṯi kmo, ḥoṯi ste, gdomanno: “Kale mṭeli Qambar Zaman, gəmsahanna, balki nopəl raḥa eba, d qədro qaymo w yətwo.” Omər: “Ya aḥuno, hat kəḏʕat.”
data.translation: Bruder Qambar Zaman! - Was ist? - Ich will mich hier in einem Zimmer niederlassen und gehen und meine Schwester ein Paar Tagetrösten, unterhalten. Ich werde meiner Schwester sagen: Hier, ich habe Qambar Zaman hergebracht! Vielleicht findet sie dann Ruhe, daß sie stehen und sitzen kann. -Bruder, das weißt du am besten. -

rationale: Thin Infectum cell: nominal sister object and assimilated 1sg msahanno; retains the edition’s shared rendering of the repeated comfort predicates.

summary: Active comforting takes a person as bare NP or suffix. The fronted Qambar Zaman at 97/42 is the patient on the contextual reading, not automatically the subject.
The purpose d msahele at 97/41 is Infectum despite surface identity with Preterit msahele; narrative gəmsahele at 97/42 independently identifies the Infectum.

The edition compresses W msahele and Qambar Zaman ġalabe gəmsahele into one German sentence. 97/49 likewise does not separately render every comforting predicate. Keep the original combined translation and context, rather than translating missing clauses.
Detransitive contexts describe becoming reassured or finding emotional calm without an overt agent. This is the inherited comforting meaning, not a new numbered active sense.
The Detransitive Infectum citation mismatch is repaired from 113/56 to the supplied 113/50, resolving the inherited Russian absence note.
97/42: confirm the patient-fronting interpretation of Qambar Zaman, especially the scope of ġalabe across the two comforting predicates. The edition supports it but combines the predicates.
